responseText:
We weren't just lucky the portal opened here. The mountain called the Dunir home. This is my birthright, shaped in stone, forge, and memory. 

The statues and the Heartwood are part of that legacy.Go see them for yourself. Stand where my ancestors once stood. Feel what it means to belong to Mount Dun.
name: ANV_FTUE_Vignette_Dunir_Historian_8_Response
